high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Wikipedia page titled "Robert Sapolsky." The page provides information about Robert Morris Sapolsky, an American neuroendocrinology researcher and author. The text indicates that he was born on April 6, 1957, and currently holds the positions of professor of biology, professor of neurology and neurological sciences, and by courtesy, professor of neurosurgery at Stanford University. Additionally, he is a research associate at the National Museums of Kenya.
